notObserved.title: Measure J - San Lorenzo USD - Education Parcel Tax
notObserved.finding: No Measure J in any of the five photos. Its absence from the complete BT87 ballot remains unverified because Card C back is not photographed.

unverifiedBackside.consequence: Could be blank or contain additional contests; do not certify total ballot size or assert Measure J absent solely from these five photos.

publicGuideCrosscheck.sourcePageNotes: BT11 comparison comes from official county PDF pages 64–75. Those are not BT87 source pages. The locally saved composite includes 46 distinct sample styles but no decoded BT87 label; no complete public BT87 sample located in this limited check.

interpretation: Model trials remain observations on frozen BT11; no trial responses or inputs were changed.
Comparisons restricted to the 14 statewide propositions and RTM use items visibly shared with these photos.
Measure J should be excluded from any claim of a photo-matched analysis unless the missing side or a complete official BT87 sample verifies it.
Candidate selections outside the congressional replacement can be compared by matched contest; self-reported compass scores still reflect the original full BT11 response.
